workflow: The gsd:insert-phase workflow uses decimal numbering and an (INSERTED) marker in ROADMAP.md to handle mid-milestone urgent work without disrupting existing phase numbering.
When a todo is superseded by a new phase rather than completed directly, it should be moved to done/ with a note indicating supersession and the phase number.
Inserting a phase immediately after the current active phase (rather than later) is preferable when there are no dependency blockers and downstream phases would benefit from the work.

friction: Initial phase insertion suggestion placed the phase at 20.1 (between Phase 20 and 21) — user had to correct this to 19.1 to slot it immediately after the current phase.
